items.title: Introducing context-aware vulnerability discovery and remediation with Cloudflare Managed Defense and OpenAI Daybreak models

sentences.en: Introducing context-aware vulnerability discovery and remediation with Cloudflare Managed Defense and OpenAI Daybreak models.
sentences.zh: 借助Cloudflare托管防御和OpenAI Daybreak模型，推出上下文感知漏洞发现和补救措施。

sentences.en: Your scanner just flagged 4,000 new vulnerabilities, 78 of them critical.
sentences.zh: 您的扫描仪刚刚标记了4,000个新漏洞，其中78个是严重漏洞。

sentences.en: Which one do you fix first?
sentences.zh: 您首先修复哪一个？

sentences.en: To answer that question, Cloudflare is announcing early access to Vulnerability Discovery and Remediation, now part of Cloudflare Managed Defense .
sentences.zh: 为了回答这个问题， Cloudflare宣布提前访问漏洞发现和修复，现在是Cloudflare托管防御的一部分。

sentences.en: Vulnerability Discovery and Remediation is a new, invitation-only Cloudflare service that helps customers detect and mitigate vulnerabilities in their codebases.
sentences.zh: 漏洞发现和修复是一项仅限邀请的新Cloudflare服务，可帮助客户检测和缓解其代码库中的漏洞。

sentences.en: Through the OpenAI Daybreak Defense Network , we use OpenAI Daybreak models, including GPT-5.6 Cyber, for reconnaissance, hunting, and validation against codebases that you authorize us to access.
sentences.zh: 通过OpenAI Daybreak Defense Network ，我们使用OpenAI Daybreak模型（包括GPT-5.6 Cyber ）对您授权我们访问的代码库进行侦察、狩猎和验证。

sentences.en: If we detect a vulnerability, we will then propose solutions to you, automatically checking each proposed patch and any accompanying proposed mitigation before presenting them for review.
sentences.zh: 如果我们检测到漏洞，我们将向您提出解决方案，自动检查每个建议的补丁和任何随附的缓解措施，然后再将其提交审核。

sentences.en: Importantly, you are in the driver’s seat: while we may propose code patches and other mitigations, you decide whether they are implemented.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，您是司机：虽然我们可能会提出代码补丁和其他缓解措施，但您可以决定是否实施。

sentences.en: Choosing what to fix first has always been hard.
sentences.zh: 首先选择要修复的内容一直很困难。

sentences.en: It's getting harder.
sentences.zh: 越来越难了。

sentences.en: Large language models can now surface weaknesses across a codebase in minutes , which means the number of findings keeps climbing.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型现在可以在几分钟内在代码库中发现弱点，这意味着发现的数量不断攀升。

sentences.en: But the real problem is speed.
sentences.zh: 但真正的问题是速度。

items.title: AI data centres are booming in Australia - but at what cost?

sentences.en: AI data centres are booming in Australia - but at what cost?.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚的人工智能数据中心正在蓬勃发展，但代价是什么？

sentences.en: Advocates say data centres will bring jobs but others worry they will suck up resources while providing little advantage.
sentences.zh: 支持者表示，数据中心将带来就业机会，但其他人担心它们会吸收资源，同时几乎没有提供优势。

items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: DRA Updates

sentences.en: Kubernetes v1.37: DRA Updates.
sentences.zh: Kubernetes v 1.37 ： DRA更新。

sentences.en: Kubernetes 1.37 is here and Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA) keeps pushing past where it started!
sentences.zh: Kubernetes 1.37来了，动态资源分配（ DRA ）一直在超越它开始的地方！

sentences.en: This release brings DRA Extended Resource support to GA, a milestone the team has been building toward for three straight releases.
sentences.zh: 此版本为GA带来了DRA扩展资源支持，这是团队连续三次发布的一个里程碑。

sentences.en: Several more features graduate to Beta or GA.
sentences.zh: 还有几个功能可以升级到Beta版或GA版。

sentences.en: A fresh batch of alpha features rounds out the release.
sentences.zh: 一批新的Alpha功能完善了发布。

sentences.en: I'll dive into what's new for DRA in Kubernetes 1.37!
sentences.zh: 我将深入了解Kubernetes 1.37中DRA的新功能！

sentences.en: What's stable in 1.37 DRA Extended Resource support has graduated to GA.
sentences.zh: 1.37 DRA扩展资源支持中的稳定内容已升级到GA。

sentences.en: This is the mechanism that lets DRA drivers satisfy requests made through the traditional extended resource API, think example.com/gpu in a Pod spec, without requiring a separate device plugin alongside the DRA driver.
sentences.zh: 这是一种机制，允许DRA驱动程序满足通过传统扩展资源API （ Pod规范中的example.com/gpu ）提出的请求，而无需与DRA驱动程序一起使用单独的设备插件。

sentences.en: An extended resource name can be set directly on a DeviceClass, and Pods requesting it get matched to a device through DRA with no ResourceClaim needed on the workload's part.
sentences.zh: 可以直接在DeviceClass上设置扩展资源名称，请求它的Pod通过DRA与设备匹配，而工作负载不需要ResourceClaim。

sentences.en: It's been on a steady path since KEP acceptance in 1.34.
sentences.zh: 自1.34年KEP接受以来，它一直在稳步前进。

sentences.en: Alpha landed in 1.35, Beta in 1.36, and now it's Stable.
sentences.zh: 阿尔法落在1.35 ，贝塔落在1.36 ，现在稳定了。

sentences.en: For cluster operators, this is what makes DRA adoption gradual.
sentences.zh: 对于集群运营商来说，这就是DRA逐渐被采用的原因。

items.title: Nobel laureate Machado: ‘Illegitimate’ Venezuela regime has no right to strike US oil deal

sentences.en: Nobel laureate Machado: ‘Illegitimate’ Venezuela regime has no right to strike US oil deal.
sentences.zh: 诺贝尔奖获得者马查多： “非法”的委内瑞拉政权无权达成美国石油协议。

sentences.en: Opposition leader says interim government lacking democratic mandate to negotiate on natural resources • The US and Venezuela: a century-old relationship drenched in oil The Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado has questioned Donald Trump’s oil deal with Venezuela’s interim government, saying the country’s natural resources do not belong to “an illegitimate regime”.
sentences.zh: 反对派领导人表示，临时政府缺乏就自然资源进行谈判的民主授权•美国和委内瑞拉：一段长达百年的石油关系委内瑞拉反对派领导人玛丽亚·科里纳·马查多（ María Corina Machado ）质疑唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）与委内瑞拉临时政府的石油协议，称该国的自然资源不属于“非法政权”。

sentences.en: In her first public comments since Trump announced what he called “the biggest oil deal in world history” with Venezuela last Friday, Machado walked a diplomatic tightrope between challenging the agreement and trying not to rile the White House.
sentences.zh: 自特朗普上周五宣布与委内瑞拉达成他所谓的“世界历史上最大的石油交易”以来，马查多首次公开发表评论，在挑战该协议和尽量避免激怒白宫之间的外交钢丝绳。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Run several agents at once

sentences.en: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Run several agents at once.
sentences.zh: 适用于初学者的GitHub Copilot应用：同时运行多个代理。

sentences.en: Running multiple AI agents on the same project seems like pure chaos, with too many cooks in your development kitchen.
sentences.zh: 在同一个项目上运行多个AI代理似乎是纯粹的混乱，你的开发厨房里有太多的厨师。

sentences.en: But with the GitHub Copilot app , these agents work separately and don t interfere with each other, allowing you to get more done in less time.
sentences.zh: 但是，使用GitHub Copilot应用程序，这些代理可以单独工作，不会相互干扰，从而让您在更短的时间内完成更多工作。

sentences.en: Think of parallel agent sessions like a trip to the laundromat.
sentences.zh: 想象一下并行代理会话，就像去洗衣店一样。

sentences.en: You can start multiple loads of laundry at the same time, in their own machines.
sentences.zh: 您可以在自己的机器上同时开始多次洗衣。

sentences.en: You can set each washer with its own settings, and it won t impact the other loads.
sentences.zh: 您可以使用自己的设置设置每个垫圈，它不会影响其他负载。

sentences.en: Most importantly, you don t have to wait for one to finish before you can start another one.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，您不必等待一个完成就可以开始另一个。

sentences.en: Let s look at how it works.
sentences.zh: 我们来看看它的工作原理

sentences.en: Agent sessions, Git worktrees, and context An agent session is a task you ve given Copilot, start to finish.
sentences.zh: 座席会话、Git工作树和上下文座席会话是您赋予Copilot的任务，从开始到结束。

sentences.en: In the GitHub Copilot app, you can manage several sessions through the sessions view.
sentences.zh: 在GitHub Copilot应用中，您可以通过会话视图管理多个会话。

sentences.en: Each card shows its title and how far along the agent is in completing its task.
sentences.zh: 每张卡片都会显示其标题以及代理完成任务的距离。

sentences.en: Each session runs independently of the others.
sentences.zh: 每个会话独立于其他会话运行。
